main.description: Lists an account among those that may create scopes, or takes it off the list. The list matters while the registry lets only its admins and the accounts they list create scopes ('scopeCreation' is 'listed' in describeRegistry). Taking an account off leaves the scopes it created. The caller must be one of the registry's admins.

allowed.description: True lists the account; false takes it off the list.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not one of the registry's admins.
